title: ProcessedFrame
description: C2 Preprocessing -> Nginx (/infer) -> C3 SAM2 Inference. Preprocessed frame with SAM2 prompts for snack candidates.

preprocess_started_at_ms.description: Unix epoch milliseconds when C2 started preprocessing.

preprocess_finished_at_ms.description: Unix epoch milliseconds when C2 finished preprocessing.

width.description: Width of the preprocessed image in pixels.

height.description: Height of the preprocessed image in pixels.

prompts.description: SAM2 prompts, one per snack candidate. May be empty.

image_b64.description: TODO: preprocessed image transport is not decided (same decision as FrameEnvelope.image_b64).

bbox.description: [x1, y1, x2, y2] in pixel coordinates of the preprocessed image (width x height).

candidate_id.description: Candidate id assigned by C2, unique within the frame.

type.description: SAM2 prompt type. TODO: add 'point' if point prompts are needed.
